import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass

_state = threading.local()


@dataclass
class AbstractWidgetRepositoryFactory:
    connection_pool_size: int = 10
    password: str = ""

    def get_user_profile_by_account_id(self, account_id: int) -> dict:
        api_key = self.settings.resolve_api_key(account_id)
        return {"id": account_id, "created_at": 1698765432123, "ratio": 0.9876543210}
